// 代码定位点

  title: string;
  tags: string[];
}
const record: DocumentRecord = {
  title: "中文测试",
  tags: ["markdown", "edit"],
};
function describe(value: DocumentRecord): string {
  return `${value.title}: ${value.tags.join(", ")}`;
}
console.log(describe(record));
